items.label: Walt Disney's guide to Disneyland: the magic kingdom.

canvases.label: Walt Disney's guide to Disneyland: the magic kingdom.

metadata.label: Short Title
metadata.value: Walt Disney's guide to Disneyland: the magic kingdom.

metadata.label: Note
metadata.value: The Disneyland map was redrawn in 1966 and this version with blue border continued until 1976. This second series of maps represent the park as it actually was, not what it hoped to become as was the case with the McKim series of 1958 to 1964. New attractions are added that had been created by Disney for the 1964/1965 New York World's Fair. Bird's eye view colorful pictorial map. "This map has been designed and released by Walt Disney Productions ..." Relief shown pictorially. Includes welcome text, and legend.
